## Wave 3 Summary

This wave harvests the S110 fermion-mass relocation. S110 established two structural facts that this wave extends. (1) The up-sector ε_LX texture (`S110-CF2-YUK-EPSLX`, INFO, `mass_grp=2/6`) reaches the up-sector ratios r_cu/r_tc in-band via a pairing-dependent off-diagonal texture, but leaves 4 of 6 mass-group slots HELD (the 3 same-generation Λ_u=Λ_d J-conjugacy locks + the down-only m_s/m_d). (2) The rank-1 Yukawa wall is now off-ALL-left-invariant-internal-moduli (`S110-CF1-YUK-C2COSET`, FAIL: Schur-zero leading derivative `|dY₁₂/dδ|₀=8.73e-16`), so the hierarchy's home is the external non-left-invariant ε_LX on the multiplicity bundle — the permanent content of §VII.BL (Generation-Blindness Obstruction, STAGE-3-PERMANENT, S99 W3-1).

Four items: (1) full-flavor Yukawa magnitude — extend the up-sector texture to the down-sector ε_LX texture + CKM angles + the same-gen J-conjugacy lock, gating `mass_grp ≥ 5/6`. (2) the productive C²-coset relocation as a Weinberg-angle / a₂-response SLOPE (a NEW sensitivity observable on the irrep-leg spectrum, distinct from the INV12-W2-1 a₂-additivity-leak BOUND). (3) the C²-coset Yukawa-rank confirmation witness (S110-CF1 down-tiered) with a PRE-REGISTERED dual prior ~0.90 FAIL / ~0.10 PASS, the PASS branch wired to a flagged §VII.BL Stage-2 CONTRADICTION. (4) the HIGH-effort categorical construct-or-obstruct for the M1 intertwiner — NAME a non-ACM vertically-elliptic σ_v threading both conjuncts of the §VII.W-3 two-axis obstruction, OR prove the categorical obstruction theorem; two conjuncts pre-assigned to two axes (van-den-dungen Axis-2 / connes Axis-1).

**Substrate framing (whole wave).** The Yukawa couplings are spectral data of `(A_K, H_K, D_K)`: `Y_ij = ∫_K ψ̄_i (dD_K/dδ) ψ_j` is a matrix element of the Dirac-operator variation between the lowest-|λ| generation eigenvectors. The §VII.BL theorem says the bare `D_K` left-invariant ⇒ Peter-Weyl multiplicity-scalar ⇒ generations are the multiplicity index (Z₃-triality `t=(p−q) mod 3`), so no A_K-built form lifts the degeneracy. The hierarchy IS a feature of the external non-LI deformation ε_LX on the multiplicity-bundle complement of the Hochschild 1-cochain `[D_K,−]` image. Direction of explanation: `D_K eigenvalues → ε_LX multiplicity-bundle deformation → Yukawa textures → fermion masses + CKM`. The M1 intertwiner sub-question is GEOMETRIC/PARTICLE at the K-homology layer: whether the inheritance morphism χ: A_K → M₂(ℂ) is a Kasparov shriek (faithful) or the Connes-Karoubi zero-map (DELETION); S110 W1 derived Reading B (DELETION) on two orthogonal-companion axes, leaving a single atomic categorical residue.

## §W3-2. S111-CF-WEINBERG-C2COSET

```yaml
# ---- Identity (7 fields) ----
gate_id: "S111-CF-WEINBERG-C2COSET"
schema_version: "R3"
gate_type: "compute"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "GEOMETRIC"
agent_type: "baptista-spacetime-analyst"
hypothesis: "Under the T4 C^2-split left-invariant deformation L3.I_4 -> diag(...) on C2_IDX=[3,4,5,6] at the fold tau-anchor, the Weinberg-angle response slope d(sin^2 theta_W)/d(delta_C2)|_0 is nonzero (|slope| > eps_sens) with sign matching the 3L2/(L1+3L2) substitution chain, demonstrating the C^2-coset is a PRODUCTIVE (response-bearing) relocation even though it is rank-1-null for Yukawas."

method:
  description: >
    Compute the response SLOPE d(sin^2 theta_W)/d(delta_C2)|_0 and d(a2)/d(delta_C2)|_0 under
    the T4 C^2-split deformation on C2_IDX=[3,4,5,6] at tau_fold. Re-use the inv2 deformed-split
    machinery (deformed_su2_split_metric) but SWAP the split block from SU2_IDX=[0,1,2] to
    C2_IDX=[3,4,5,6]: split L3.I_4 -> diag(L3 e^{+3 delta}, L3 e^{-delta}, L3 e^{-delta},
    L3 e^{-delta}), volume-preserving within the 4-block (3 delta - 3 delta = 0). The
    Weinberg angle is sin^2 theta_W(delta_C2) = 3 L2(delta_C2) / (L1 + 3 L2(delta_C2)) where
    L1, L2 are the u(1)/su(2) leg eigenvalues of the Josephson stiffness g_K (the 3 is the
    GUT 5/3 hypercharge normalization; the bare Baptista form L2/(L1+L2) is reported as a
    cross-check). The a2 Seeley-DeWitt coefficient (G_N-feeding) is read off the heat-trace
    second moment of D_K(delta_C2). Compute both slopes by centered 4th-order finite difference
    in delta_C2 at delta=0. Output the SLOPE values + sign + regime tag.
  producing_script: "computations/session-111/s111_weinberg_c2coset_offjensen.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality"
  form: "|d(sin^2 theta_W)/d(delta_C2)|_0| > eps_sens ; AND sign(d(sin^2)/d(delta_C2)|_0) == sign(dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0)"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "eps_sens = 1e-3"
  direction: ">"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "the sign is analytic (d(sin^2)/dL2 = 3 L1/(L1+3 L2)^2 > 0 always; Sage-verified this plan-freeze); the MAGNITUDE threshold eps_sens=1e-3 is a sensitivity floor (numerical-zero discriminator), matching the inv2 eps_lift=1e-3"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous — slope is a real-valued finite-difference derivative"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "5-point centered finite-difference stencil in delta_C2 at delta=0 (4th-order)"
  L_max: "12 (s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz; the irrep-leg eigenvalues feeding L1/L2/a2 are L_max-saturated)"
  scan_range: "delta_C2 in [-h_fd, +h_fd], h_fd = 1e-2 (finite-difference half-step; same window class as inv2 perturbative scan); the slope is the delta=0 derivative"
  step_size: "h_fd = 1e-2 (centered 4th-order stencil delta in {-2h, -h, 0, +h, +2h})"
  tolerance: "eps_sens = 1e-3 (slope-magnitude floor); finite-difference truncation cross-checked by halving h_fd (Richardson, demand stencil convergence < 1%)"
  scheme: "off-Jensen-C2coset-split-spectral-action-a2"
  convention: "deformed-L3.I4-split-metric-C2coset-4bonds-JC2-0.9330; sin^2=3L2/(L1+3L2) GUT-normalized; a2-ratio FI-tagged"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (finite-difference)"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg.eigvalsh (D_K(delta_C2) per-block eigvals on GPU; largest block dim 9792 fits 17.1 GB VRAM with margin; cross-check first eigvals vs numpy on a small block)"
  regulator_pin: "a_2^{zeta} (the G_N-feeding Seeley-DeWitt second moment; poleconv-A-double, pole_in_s=3, curvature_grade_n=2); FI-tagged per regulator-pin-discipline.md §β_shell FI Classification (a2-ratio parented to the F_traj a2-ratio FI theorem at locked-norm L_k=1)"
  publication_precision: "4 — slope values to 4 sig figs (downstream rel_tol >= 1e-4)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "d(sin^2 theta_W)/d(delta_C2)|_0 has the sign of dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0; the Weinberg
            angle is a monotone-increasing function of the su(2)-leg eigenvalue L2."
    Step 1: sin^2 theta_W = 3 L2 / (L1 + 3 L2)  [GUT 5/3-normalized Weinberg form; Baptista
            session-29 collab form L2/(L1+L2) is the bare-normalization cross-check].
    Step 2: L1 = u(1)-leg eigenvalue of g_K > 0; L2 = su(2)-leg eigenvalue of g_K > 0
            [Josephson stiffness positivity; J_u1=0.038, J_su2=0.059, J_C2=0.933 are the
            stiffnesses, all > 0; canonical_constants.py:734-736].
    Step 3: d(sin^2 theta_W)/d L2 = d/dL2 [ 3 L2 / (L1 + 3 L2) ]
                                  = [3(L1 + 3 L2) - 3 L2 * 3] / (L1 + 3 L2)^2
                                  = 3 L1 / (L1 + 3 L2)^2   [Sage-verified this plan-freeze:
                                    3*L1/(L1 + 3*L2)^2].
    Step 4: L1 > 0 and (L1 + 3 L2)^2 > 0  =>  d(sin^2 theta_W)/d L2 = 3 L1/(L1+3 L2)^2 > 0
            (strictly positive ALWAYS).
    Canonical form: d(sin^2 theta_W)/d(delta_C2)|_0 = [3 L1/(L1+3 L2)^2] * dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0.
    Direction: the bracket is > 0 => sign(d(sin^2)/d(delta_C2)|_0) = sign(dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0).
            The C^2-split deformation L3.I_4 -> diag perturbs the su(2)-block eigenvalues via
            Cholesky-frame coupling; the producing script REPORTS the computed sign of
            dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0 (an OUTPUT) and the sign_verdict PASSes iff the computed
            d(sin^2)/d(delta_C2)|_0 sign matches sign(dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0).
    Conclusion: the SIGN is locked to dL2/d(delta_C2)|_0 by the monotone-increasing
            relation; the gate's job is the MAGNITUDE (is the slope > eps_sens, i.e. does
            the C^2-coset register a Weinberg-angle response at all).

# (8) input_files
input_files:
```

```yaml
    foreclosure (the ACM shriek carries the finite fibre algebra INTACT, has NO finite-summand-
    quotient operation, cannot realize A_F -> A_F/M_3 as a fibre-integration) to ALL SU(3)->CP^2
    C*-algebra-homomorphism constructions: prove no homomorphism-type construction realizes the
    Wedderburn quotient A_K -> A_K/M_3(C) as a fibre-integration (SELECTION = sub-object
    retention != DELETION = Wedderburn quotient). CONJUNCT (ii) [THE IMAGE; connes Axis-1 /
    K-homology / algebra-INVARIANT / Fredholm-index side]: extend the one-bridge anchor
    [phi_cd]=(0,0,0) (gate S93-W2-1, B=iota_*.HKR sends the M_3-gap-class to (0,0,0) in
    K^0(A_K)=Z^3, residual 0.00e+00) to the ALL-bridge-maps statement: every K-natural bridge
    map sends the M_3-generator of K^0(A_K)=Z^3 to zero (Morita invariance: K_0(M_3(C))=K_0(C)=Z;
    an internal shriek changes the TARGET pairing at most, never the source, so a re-route needs
    an image both non-zero (faithful) AND =(0,0,0) (gate) — contradiction). The JOINT PASS for
    a CONSTRUCTION requires an explicit sigma_v threading BOTH; the JOINT PASS for the
    OBSTRUCTION requires BOTH conjuncts foreclosed (Axis-2 forecloses (i), Axis-1 forecloses (ii));
    vertical ellipticity (sigma(D) invertible in all fibre-orthogonal directions, 1811.07824 Thm
    3.4 defining hypothesis) makes a zero-image-while-faithful shriek a contradiction in terms.
  producing_script: "computations/session-111/s111_m1_intertwiner.py"

# ---- gate_type note ----
# This is gate_type: compute (it emits a verdict line — a registry-landing of either the
# explicit sigma_v construction OR the obstruction theorem). It is HIGH-effort / multi-wave
# and is a JOINT cross-axis construct-or-obstruct. The two conjuncts dispatch IN PARALLEL to

# obstruction record.

# (1) operator

  type: "set"

    selection) == ker(iota_*)=M_3(C)] AND [K-homology-class(sigma_v) != 0]. OBSTRUCT-PASS iff

            integration (conjunct i foreclosed).
    Step 4: a FAITHFUL shriek REQUIRES a non-trivial image (vertical ellipticity, Step 1) =>
            zero-image-while-faithful is a contradiction. Conjunct (i) forecloses SELECTION;
            conjunct (ii) forecloses non-zero IMAGE. Both halves independently impossible.
    Canonical form: (faithful => non-zero image) AND (M_3-generator -> 0 for all bridges) AND
            (no fibre-integration realizes the Wedderburn quotient) => no sigma_v threads both.
    Direction: the two-conjunct obstruction theorem holds (OBSTRUCT-PASS) UNLESS a construction
```
